text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Alert 1765432100 — hosted-api-us-east queue length > 12k (90s) — p95 latency spike to 2.3s, p99 to 9.8s, error rate up (504s). Autoscales failing to add nodes (see logs). Paging oncall.

Sara Nguyen: I'm on it — jumping to metrics. Can someone grab the autoscaler logs?

Mike Chen: looking. Seeing a sustained incoming request rate bump from a single API key (key=acct_85f...) starting ~1765431980. Traffic profile is long-context generation requests (seq len ~2048).

Carlos Rivera: > That key is from a third-party analytics partner — no rate limits at client side. Could be a runaway job.

Julie Park: p95 for hosted-api-us-east is 2300ms, p99 ~9800ms, 504 spike. Queue length at inference-router is 12.4k. GPU pools report 100% utilization, autoscaler metrics show desired=40, actual=24, scale-up attempts 9 in last 6m.

Sara Nguyen: ops-bot, paste autoscaler failures.

ops-bot: Autoscaler event stream: 
```
[1765432025] scale-up attempt -> FAILED: quota_exceeded (gpu_quota 30/30)
[1765432060] scale-up attempt -> FAILED: cooldown_in_progress
[1765432120] scale-up attempt -> FAILED: network_timeout to cloud api
[1765432155] scale-up attempt -> FAILED: quota_exceeded
```

Mike Chen: So autoscaler is hitting cloud GPU quota and also flapping because of cooldown config. That explains desired vs actual gap.

Sara Nguyen: Immediate mitigations: 1) throttle offending API key, 2) route high-cost requests to best-effort pool, 3) open emergency quota ticket & manually scale if possible, 4) notify CS for impacted customers. I'll start 1 and 2.

Carlos Rivera: How aggressive on throttle? We can apply a per-key soft-limit (50 rps) or hard block. Soft-limit might be ignored by the partner.

Julie Park: We're seeing retries from their client, which amplifies. If we soft-throttle they may retry and produce repeated queue growth. Recommend temporary hard throttle for that key while we stabilize.

CS-Lead: If we hard-block we need to tell the partner ASAP. I'll draft communication once we confirm.

Sara Nguyen: I'll block the key now.

deploy-bot: Running command: 
```
redwoodctl keys update acct_85f... --block --reason "emergency queue protection"
```

deploy-bot: Success — key acct_85f... blocked (1765432210).

Mike Chen: After block, ingress rate dropped ~78% within 40s. Queue length trending down from 12.4k -> 5.6k. p95 down to 980ms, p99 down to 3.2s. Error rate still elevated but improving.

ops-bot: Manual scale suggestion: create 8 g5x nodes in us-east as emergency buffer. Running preflight checks...

Carlos Rivera: Can we route new requests for higher-cost models to dedicated best-effort pool? Use fallback policy: model_variant -> small-quantized if available.

Sara Nguyen: Enabling fallback routing now (policy: pref_quantized_then_best_effort).

deploy-bot: Updating routing policy... done (1765432265).

Julie Park: After fallback + key block + policy change, queue is at 1.1k, p95 320ms, p99 890ms. 504s dropping. Good recovery trend.

CS-Lead: I've messaged the partner contacts and put them on a bridge. They're seeing backlog on their side, apologizing, claim this was a scheduled batch gone wrong. Will coordinate root cause with them.

Sara Nguyen: Follow-ups while hot: create monitoring alert for per-key request rate spikes (threshold 1k/s sustained 30s), tighten autoscaler cooldown logic to not prevent emergency ramp when queue > 5k, add quota escalation playbook doc.

Carlos Rivera: Also: consider per-key circuit breaker that flips to 429s before queue reaches backend saturation.

Mike Chen: Noted for QoS work. I'll open a tracking ticket.

ops-bot: Incident snapshot: 
- start: 1765432100 (pagerbot alert)
- major mitigations: block key (1765432210), enable fallback routing (1765432265), manual scale queued (requested to cloud)
- impact: elevated p95/p99 and 504s for ~18m; partial outage for heavy-gen customers; host-level CPU/GPU saturation in us-east; autoscaler failed due to cloud gpu quota and cooldown.

Sara Nguyen: Any remaining customer-facing errors? Julie?

Julie Park: A small subset of customers using long-gen models saw >10s tail latencies or 504s for ~15 minutes. Most traffic returned to healthy. We should notify SLA ops and update status page.

CS-Lead: Drafting status update for affected customers now. Also requesting partner to backfill logs for their scheduled job.

Carlos Rivera: Post-incident action items I propose: 
- per-key rate limiter + circuit breaker (high priority)
- autoscaler: add emergency path that ignores cooldown if queue > threshold and cloud quota available
- playbook: pre-approved cloud quota escalation steps + runbook contacts
- add model-fallback heuristics to avoid long-gen hitting the hosted pool (route to dedicated or best-effort).

Sara Nguyen: Agreed. Adding to incident tracker. Also need a retro to review why quota was not preemptively increased for anticipated growth in us-east.

Mike Chen: One more data point — logs show 3 distinct client IP subnets for that key; partner claims it was a controlled batch from multiple workers.

Sara Nguyen: Thanks all. I'll keep this thread updated with the ticket numbers and status page link. Moving to monitoring watch for next 2 hours.

deploy-bot: Cloud quota ticket created: TICKET-9931 (1765432330). Manual GPU create in progress (if quota approved).

Sara Nguyen: final note for now: incident containment achieved at 1765432332. We'll reconvene for a 30m postmortem at 1765433800.

Carlos Rivera: :thumbsup: great work.

CS-Lead: Sending customer note now.

pagerbot: Incident severity set to Sev2, incident_state=contained (1765432332).
